mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.fait_parti (cip, discussion_id, etat) VALUES (#{cip}, #{discussionId},'enabled') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO app.fait_parti (cip, discussion_id, etat) VALUES
(#{cip}, #{discussionId}, 'active')
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT fp.discussion_id as discussionId, fp2.cip as cip, u.pseudo as pseudo, fp.etat as etat, m.date_ as lastMessageDate FROM app.fait_parti fp JOIN app.fait_parti fp2 ON fp.discussion_id = fp2.discussion_id AND fp2.cip != fp.cip JOIN app.discussion d ON fp.discussion_id = d.discussion_id JOIN app.utilisateur u ON fp2.cip = u.cip LEFT JOIN app.message m ON m.discussion_id = fp.discussion_id AND m.date_ = ( SELECT MAX(m2.date_) FROM app.message m2 WHERE m2.discussion_id = fp.discussion_id ) LEFT JOIN app.equipe e ON e.discussion_id = fp.discussion_id WHERE fp.cip = #{cip} AND e.equipe_id IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.fait_parti fp3 WHERE fp3.discussion_id = fp.discussion_id) = 2 UNION ALL SELECT NULL as discussionId, c.cip_contact as cip, u.pseudo as pseudo, 'enabled' as etat, NULL as lastMessageDate FROM app.contact c JOIN app.utilisateur u ON c.cip_contact = u.cip WHERE c.cip = #{cip} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app.fait_parti fp WHERE fp.discussion_id IN ( SELECT fp3.discussion_id FROM app.fait_parti fp3 LEFT JOIN app.equipe e2 ON e2.discussion_id = fp3.discussion_id WHERE fp3.cip = #{cip} AND e2.equipe_id IS NULL AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app.fait_parti fp4 WHERE fp4.discussion_id = fp3.discussion_id) = 2 ) AND fp.cip = c.cip_contact ) ORDER BY lastMessageDate DESC NULLS LAST
